ROUTER DNS ROUTING
Only pinned devices' lookups go through a tunnel.
read 04:09:30

== YOUR DEVICES' LOOKUPS ==
wgc1:pia-aus_perth → 9.9.9.9 [wgc1:pia-aus_perth, encrypted to PIA] - TABLET
Everything else → dnsmasq → stubby → 1.1.1.2, 1.0.0.2 [Internet, encrypted (DoT)] - DNS-over-TLS

== THE ROUTER'S OWN LOOKUPS ==
1.1.1.2 [Internet, not encrypted] - DNS Server setting, ordinary DNS
1.0.0.2 [Internet, not encrypted] - DNS Server setting, ordinary DNS
127.0.1.1 stubby [Internet, encrypted (DoT)] - to 1.1.1.2 and 1.0.0.2, only if both of the above fail

== THE SLOTS' DNS SERVERS ==
No slot has DNS servers set.

== EVIDENCE ==

DNS routing rules (ip rule, iif lo)
Which tunnel carries the router's own lookups to each address. The lowest rule number wins.
(none: every address goes out your internet connection)

DNS redirects (VPN_FUSION)
Pinned devices' lookups to the router, sent on to their slot's first DNS server.
-N VPN_FUSION
-A VPN_FUSION -s 192.168.1.55/32 -d 192.168.1.254/32 -p udp -m udp --dport 53 -j DNAT --to-destination 9.9.9.9

Slot DNS settings (nvram)
Each slot's DNS servers, as set in MANAGE or the web interface.
wgc1_dns=  # wgc1:pia-aus_perth
wgc2_dns=  # wgc2:pia-au_adelaide-pf
wgc3_dns=  # wgc3:pia-au_brisbane-pf
wgc4_dns=  # not configured
wgc5_dns=  # wgc5:pia-aus_melbourne
